seo.baslik: Modules and Industry Packages: QR Menu, Booking, AI Assistant | Mehmet KURU
seo.aciklama: QR menu, digital business card, appointments, AI assistant, email marketing, field service and more: see what each module does and request a quote.

liste.giris: We switch on the modules you need in your client portal: from QR menus to appointments, from an AI assistant to email marketing. See what each module does, then request the one that fits or a package prepared for your industry.
liste.paketlerGiris: We grouped modules that are often used together by type of business. Request a package as it is, or pick modules one by one.
liste.yakindaGiris: Modules we are working on. Their pages will appear here once they are released; join the waitlist on the roadmap to hear about them first.
liste.temellerGiris: These are not sold as separate modules: they are already switched on in the panel of every client we work with.

kategori.dijital_kimlik: How your business shows up on phones, tables and printed material: business card, QR codes, menu, catalog and review page.
kategori.is_araclari: Tools that speed up daily work: appointments, automation, AI assistant, email marketing, events and tickets.
kategori.icerik: For preparing and planning social media and blog content.
kategori.sektorel: Modules built around the workflow of a specific industry.
kategori.hizmet: For your website and for working with our team: monitoring, renewals, files, API and expert assistants.
kategori.analiz: A regular report on your website and the work done.

detay.bulunamadiAciklama: The page you are looking for may have been removed or moved. You can browse all modules instead.
detay.hazirKurulumAciklama: When the pack is enabled, starter settings for the option that fits your business are added too; they only fill empty places and you can change everything later.

fiyat.profilNotu: The amount depends on the profile you choose (corporate, startup, NGO…) and how you pay; there is no extra charge for this module on top of the package.
fiyat.teklifMetni: This module is switched on separately. We price it according to your usage and needs; fill in the form and we will send you a tailored quote.
fiyat.paketTeklifMetni: The package is priced according to the modules you choose and your usage; fill in the form and we will send you a tailored quote.

form.notYerTutucu: E.g. number of locations or users, what you use today, when you would like to start

cta.baslik: Not sure which one is right for you?
cta.metin: Tell us about your business and how you work today, and we will choose the modules that will genuinely help, together.

restoran_kafe.ozet: Ordering from the table, takeaway orders over WhatsApp and more Google reviews, all in one.
restoran_kafe.kimIcin: Restaurants, cafés, patisseries, bars and takeaway businesses.
restoran_kafe.neden: The QR menu speeds up ordering at the table, the WhatsApp catalog gathers a takeaway order into a single message, and the Google review page makes it easy for happy guests to leave a review. With a dynamic QR code you can change the link on your table cards without reprinting them.

klinik_guzellik.ozet: Online booking, a shareable digital business card and an AI assistant that answers common questions.
klinik_guzellik.kimIcin: Clinics, dental and beauty salons, hairdressers, psychologists, dietitians, lawyers and consultants.
klinik_guzellik.neden: The booking page cuts down phone traffic, the digital business card shares your contact details in one tap, and the AI assistant answers the common questions you add to its knowledge base (address, opening hours, how to prepare). The Google review page makes it easy to leave a review after a visit.

teknik_servis.ozet: Field work with work orders, dispatch and a technician screen, plus online booking and a Google review after the job.
teknik_servis.kimIcin: Air-conditioning, boiler, appliance, cleaning, elevator and repair-and-maintenance companies.
teknik_servis.neden: Field service manages the process from the work order to the signed service form, the booking page lets customers choose a suitable time themselves, and the Google review page makes it easy to ask for a review once the job is done.

egitim_etkinlik.ozet: Course page, class schedule, attendance and certificates; event registration and QR tickets, a regular newsletter, intro calls or trial lesson bookings.
egitim_etkinlik.kimIcin: Courses, training centres, workshops, associations and anyone running seminars or open days.
egitim_etkinlik.neden: The courses module manages courses, students, attendance and certificates; the events and tickets module handles registration and check-in for seminars and open days, email marketing keeps in touch with participants, and the booking module is used for intro calls or trial lessons.

ajans_serbest.ozet: Content preparation and planning, call booking, a digital business card and automation for repetitive work.
ajans_serbest.kimIcin: Small agencies, social media managers, designers, consultants and freelancers.
ajans_serbest.neden: The content studio speeds up preparing and planning content, the booking page organises intro calls, the digital business card gathers your contact details and links on one page, and automation rules send reminder and follow-up emails for you.

eticaret_kobi.ozet: Email campaigns, an AI assistant that answers questions on your site, measurable QR codes and automation.
eticaret_kobi.kimIcin: Online stores and small and medium-sized businesses that want to stay in regular touch with their customers.
eticaret_kobi.neden: Email marketing sends campaigns and automated email sequences to your customer list, the AI assistant answers common questions on your site, dynamic QR codes measure visits from packaging and brochures, and automation rules take over repetitive work such as replying to new enquiries and sending reminders.

hukuk_burosu.ozet: Matter and deadline tracking, initial meeting and consultation bookings, an inactive business card draft, internal documents and notes.
hukuk_burosu.neden: The law office module manages clients, matters, hearings and deadlines; booking is used for meetings, the digital business card for contact details and documents for internal notes. Because of the advertising ban, review requests and promotional tools are not included.

dinamik_qr.ozet: Change where a printed QR code points without reprinting it, and see how often it is scanned.
dinamik_qr.kimIcin: Businesses that put QR codes on posters, menus, packaging, brochures or business cards and change the link from time to time.
ozellikler: QR codes and short links whose destination you can change later
Web address, WhatsApp, Google review, vCard and Wi-Fi types
QR design in your brand colours with your logo
Scan counts and bulk creation from CSV

sss.s: Can I change the address without changing the printed QR code?
sss.c: Yes. The QR code points to your short link; you change the short link's destination in the panel whenever you like, and the printed material stays the same.

sss.s: Can I see the scans?
sss.c: Yes. The panel shows the number of scans for each QR code and how they are spread over time.

dijital_kartvizit.ozet: A digital business card and bio link page shared from your phone; saved to contacts in one tap.
dijital_kartvizit.kimIcin: Consultants, freelancers, sales teams and anyone who meets new people at fairs and meetings.
ozellikler: Save to contacts (vCard) and share with a QR code
A link preview that looks right on WhatsApp and LinkedIn
Contact form on the page, password protection if needed
Visit and click counts

sss.s: Can everyone on the team make their own card?
sss.c: Yes. Team members you add to your account can create their own cards; the number of cards per account is set in the module settings.

sss.s: If I change my details, will the link I shared break?
sss.c: No. The link stays the same, and everyone who opens the card sees the up-to-date details.

google_yorum_sayfasi.ozet: Send customers straight to the Google review screen with a QR code on a table card or receipt.
google_yorum_sayfasi.kimIcin: Local businesses that meet customers face to face, such as cafés, restaurants, clinics, shops and hairdressers.
ozellikler: A simple page with a large "Write a Google review" button
QR code for table cards, receipts or the till
Optional private feedback form
View and click counts

sss.s: Who writes the reviews?
sss.c: Your customers themselves. The page only takes them to the review screen on Google; nobody is filtered by first asking for a rating.

sss.s: Can unhappy customers tell us first?
sss.c: If you like, a private feedback form is added to the page and the messages come to you. The button for writing a Google review always stays available to every visitor.

qr_menu.ozet: A multilingual QR menu: guests scan at the table, fill their basket and send the order over WhatsApp.
qr_menu.kimIcin: Restaurants, cafés, patisseries, bars and takeaway businesses.
ozellikler: Table QR codes, categories and products with options
Allergen information and a multilingual menu
Basket, coupons and ordering over WhatsApp
Update products and prices instantly from the panel

sss.s: Does it take online payments?
sss.c: No. The order reaches you as a WhatsApp message and you take payment as usual; there is no need to set up a separate payment system.

sss.s: Can I update the menu myself?
sss.c: Yes. You change products, prices and photos in the panel; the table QR codes stay the same.

whatsapp_katalog.ozet: Show your products on a shareable storefront page and receive orders as WhatsApp messages.
whatsapp_katalog.kimIcin: Boutiques, home producers and small shops that sell through Instagram and WhatsApp.
ozellikler: Product storefront and shareable product pages
A basket that customers fill themselves
The order summary arrives as a WhatsApp message
No payment system required

sss.s: How is it different from an online store?
sss.c: There is no payment or shipping integration: the customer prepares a basket, sends the order to you over WhatsApp, and you settle the rest in the chat. It is a good way to get started quickly.

sss.s: Can it be used together with the QR menu?
sss.c: Yes. Both run on the same system; if both modules are switched on, you can set up a store in either layout.

randevu.ozet: Let customers choose a suitable time themselves, with fewer phone calls and no clashing bookings.
randevu.kimIcin: Clinics, beauty salons, consultants, trainers and any business that works by appointment.
ozellikler: Meeting types, weekly working hours and days off
Assignment within a team by person or in rotation
Calendar invite (.ics), reminder email, and cancel and reschedule links
A booking window you can embed on your website

sss.s: Does it work with Google Calendar?
sss.c: Every booking arrives as a calendar invite (.ics), and you can see your bookings in Google Calendar or Outlook through a calendar subscription link. You set your availability in the panel; other events in your calendar are not read automatically.

sss.s: Can two bookings end up at the same time?
sss.c: No. Taken slots are closed on the page, so a second booking cannot be made for the same time.

otomasyon.ozet: Hand repetitive emails, reminders and tasks over to the panel with "when this happens, do that" rules.
otomasyon.kimIcin: Small teams tired of tracking enquiries, appointments and invoices by hand.
ozellikler: Rules triggered by events such as a new enquiry, invoice, task or appointment
Conditional email, panel notification, task and webhook steps
Wait step and ready-made templates
Dry run and a 30-day run log

sss.s: Do I need to know how to code?
sss.c: No. Rules are set up with a form; you can start from a ready-made template and adjust it to suit you.

sss.s: Can it connect to Zapier or Make?
sss.c: Yes, with the webhook step. For a deeper connection there is also the API and webhooks module.

ai_asistan.ozet: A chat assistant on your website that answers visitors from your documents, pages and FAQ.
ai_asistan.kimIcin: Businesses that answer the same questions again and again, and websites that get questions outside working hours.
ozellikler: A knowledge base built from documents, website pages and FAQ
A chat window added to your site with one line of code
Shows its sources; hands over to your team when it doesn't know
Chat history and usage tracking

sss.s: What happens if it gets a question it can't answer?
sss.c: If the answer is not in the knowledge base, it says so instead of making something up and hands the visitor over to your team with a support request, which you answer from the panel.

sss.s: Is there a usage limit?
sss.c: Yes. The number of replies included each month depends on your account; when it runs out, it can continue on credits if you wish.

eposta_pazarlama.ozet: Reach your customers regularly, and with their consent, through newsletters, campaigns and automated email sequences.
eposta_pazarlama.kimIcin: Shops with a customer list, courses, event organisers and service businesses.
ozellikler: Double opt-in signup form, lists and segments
Mobile-friendly emails built with a block editor
Scheduling, A/B subject testing and delivery report
One-click unsubscribe and consent records (Turkish Law No. 6563)

sss.s: Which address are emails sent from?
sss.c: From the agency's verified domain, with your business name as the sender name; replies come to your own email address.

sss.s: Are emails sent to people without consent?
sss.c: Individual recipients only receive emails if they have given consent. Consent and unsubscribe records are kept.

etkinlik_bilet.ozet: A registration page, QR tickets and check-in at the door with a phone for your seminars, workshops and events.
etkinlik_bilet.kimIcin: Courses, training centres, associations, event organisers and businesses holding open days.
ozellikler: Registration page, ticket types, capacity and waiting list
QR ticket (PDF and add to calendar)
Check-in at the door with a phone camera
Announcement and post-event survey emails

sss.s: Can I sell paid tickets?
sss.c: At the moment, client events take free registrations. If you need paid tickets, mention it in the quote form and we will look at it together.

sss.s: Do I need a separate device at the door?
sss.c: No. The staff member's phone camera is enough; you give them the scanning link from the panel.

icerik_studyosu.ozet: Prepare social media and blog content in your brand voice with AI, and plan it on a calendar.
icerik_studyosu.kimIcin: Businesses that run their own social media, small agencies and freelance content creators.
ozellikler: Brand voice profiles and 13 ready-made content templates
Character limit checks for each channel
Social media calendar and approval flow
Short links with UTM tags, ready-to-share packages and CSV export

sss.s: Does it publish posts to social media by itself?
sss.c: No. Content is prepared as a ready-to-share package; you or the scheduling tool you use do the publishing.

sss.s: How much content can I create?
sss.c: The number of generations included each month depends on your account; when it runs out, it can continue on credits if you wish.

saha_servisi.ozet: Manage field work in one place, from the work order to the technician screen and the signed service form.
saha_servisi.kimIcin: Companies that provide on-site service, such as air-conditioning, boiler, appliance, cleaning, elevator and repair-and-maintenance firms.
ozellikler: Work orders, checklist templates and a drag-and-drop dispatch board
Mobile technician screen: photos, customer signature, location with consent
Equipment history and maintenance reminders
Service form PDF and a status page for your customer

sss.s: Do technicians need to install an app?
sss.c: No. The technician screen opens in the phone's browser, and technicians only see the jobs assigned to them.

sss.s: Is location tracked?
sss.c: There is no continuous tracking. If the technician allows it, location is recorded only when starting and finishing a job.

uzman_asistanlar.ozet: Work in the panel with AI assistants specialised in SEO, ads, social media and branding.
uzman_asistanlar.kimIcin: Business owners and small teams who run their own marketing but want help with ideas and drafts.
ozellikler: Topic-specific assistants: SEO, ads, social media, branding
Chat inside the panel; conversations are kept private to each person
Prepares ideas, text drafts and checklists
Daily usage limit set according to your account

sss.s: Do the assistants replace your team?
sss.c: No. They help with quick ideas and drafts; for important decisions and implementation you keep working with our team.

sss.s: Can anyone else see my conversations?
sss.c: No. Chats are private to each person; other people on your account cannot see them either.

uptime.ozet: Be the first to know when your website is unreachable, and show visitors a status page.
uptime.kimIcin: Any business whose website brings in sales, bookings or enquiries and that doesn't want to notice an outage late.
ozellikler: Regular availability checks of your website
Outage and recovery notifications
Public status page (optional)
Uptime history and chart

sss.s: How often is it checked?
sss.c: The check interval is set for your account to 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes.

sss.s: Is the status page mandatory?
sss.c: No. Turning it on is up to you; if you do, your visitors can see there whether there is an outage.

yenileme.ozet: Track domain, hosting, SSL and subscription expiry dates in one list and get reminded before they run out.
yenileme.kimIcin: Any business that doesn't want its website to go down because a domain or SSL certificate expired.
ozellikler: Domain, hosting, SSL and subscription renewals in one list
Email reminder before expiry
Renewal invoice and secure payment link
On the site care tab, together with your website's other details

sss.s: When does the reminder arrive?
sss.c: You are notified by email as the expiry date approaches, and you pay the renewal invoice in one step through the payment link.

sss.s: Who does the renewal?
sss.c: Our team does the renewal; all you need to do is pay the invoice.

dosyalar.ozet: Share project files securely and upload the documents we ask you for in one place.
dosyalar.kimIcin: Clients who exchange logos, images, texts or official documents with our team during a project.
ozellikler: Folders and folder-level view permissions
A list of documents requested from you, with upload
Time-limited share links with an optional password
File history in one place instead of lost in email

sss.s: Who can see the files?
sss.c: Authorised people on your account and our team. Someone you give a share link to can also see them until the link expires.

sss.s: How long is a share link valid?
sss.c: When the link is created, a validity period, an optional password and a download limit are set; once it expires, the link no longer opens.

api_erisimi.ozet: Connect your own software and automation tools to the panel: API keys, signed webhooks and MCP.
api_erisimi.kimIcin: Businesses that use Zapier, Make or n8n, or want to reach panel data from their own software.
ozellikler: Scoped API keys that can be revoked at any time
Signed webhook notifications
MCP connection for AI assistants such as Claude
Request limit per key

sss.s: What happens if I revoke a key?
sss.c: The key stops working immediately; connections using it lose access, and other keys are not affected.

sss.s: How do I know a webhook really came from the panel?
sss.c: Every notification is signed; by verifying the signature you can check that the request came from the panel.

zaman_takibi.ozet: See clearly on the project card how much time our team has spent on your project.
zaman_takibi.kimIcin: Clients who work on an hourly or revision basis and want to see the effort spent regularly.
ozellikler: Total and this month's time spent on the project card
Approved work entries only
Billable hours shown separately, where applicable
Visibility switched on per project

sss.s: Which hours are shown?
sss.c: Work time recorded by our team and approved; entries awaiting approval are not shown.

sss.s: Is it visible on every project?
sss.c: Visibility is switched on per project; projects where it is on show a time-spent summary on their card.

aylik_rapor.ozet: A client report that brings SEO, analytics, site speed and the work done together every month.
aylik_rapor.kimIcin: Businesses that want to see how their website and the work with us are going, once a month, at a glance.
ozellikler: SEO, analytics and speed summaries in one report
A list of the work done that month
A report page ready for printing and PDF
Archive of past reports in the panel

sss.s: Who prepares the report?
sss.c: The report is generated automatically from the data; our team checks it and publishes it.

sss.s: Can I access past reports?
sss.c: Yes. Published reports are archived in the Reports tab of your panel.

stok_pos.ozet: Barcoded products, stock per branch and a touch-friendly till: from sale to end of day, your stock and cash in one screen.
stok_pos.kimIcin: Small businesses that sell products, such as cafés, boutiques, corner shops, hairdressers and beauty salons.
ozellikler: Barcode scanning (camera or scanner), basket, discounts, cash/card/transfer and change
Stock per branch, stock in/out/wastage, transfers and scan-and-count stocktakes
Low-stock alerts, A4 barcode labels and CSV import/export
End-of-day report, product profit, stock value and slow-mover reports

sss.s: Does this receipt replace a fiscal cash register receipt?
sss.c: No. Receipts and end-of-day reports are informational; they do not replace a legal fiscal receipt or an e-Archive invoice.

sss.s: Do I have to re-enter my QR menu products?
sss.c: No. Import QR menu products as linked items in one click; when stock runs out they show as “sold out” on the menu.

egitim.ozet: Course page and registration, class schedule, QR attendance, online lessons, quizzes/assignments and verifiable certificates.
egitim.kimIcin: Course centres, tutoring schools, language schools, workshops, coaches and independent instructors.
ozellikler: Course page, registration form, capacity and waiting list; parent details for under-18s
Recurring class schedule, calendar and attendance by QR or code
Online lessons, files, quizzes and assignments; AI-drafted questions
Conditional certificate (PDF) and a public verification page

sss.s: Can I take course fees through the site?
sss.c: Not yet: the fee is shown as text and you describe how to pay. If you need online payments, mention it in the quote form.

sss.s: How is children's data protected?
sss.c: We never ask for a date of birth, ID number or address — only the name and the parent's contact details. Data is anonymised automatically after the period you set.

belgeler.ozet: Keep your documents, wiki and notes in one place; fill strategy templates like SWOT and Business Model Canvas with an AI draft.
belgeler.kimIcin: Small businesses and teams documenting their processes, and founders working on strategy.
ozellikler: Markdown documents, wiki and notes; checkbox to-dos and version history
8 strategy templates: SWOT, Business Model Canvas, Lean Canvas, PESTLE, Porter, McKinsey 7S, Blue Ocean, Ikigai
Write, summarize, proofread and draft templates with AI (no invented figures)
PDF, Markdown and print; sharing with the agency

sss.s: Do I need this module to read documents my agency shares with me?
sss.c: No. You can read documents shared by the agency in your panel without the module; the module is for creating your own.

sss.s: How much AI can I use?
sss.c: The monthly allowance depends on your account; when it runs out you can continue with credits if you wish.

insan_kaynaklari.ozet: Staff records, leave requests and balances, a leave calendar and a weekly shift plan; staff request leave from their own page.
insan_kaynaklari.kimIcin: Cafés, restaurants, shops, clinics, offices and agencies with shifts or leave to track.
ozellikler: Data-minimised staff records, document attachments and CSV import/export
Leave request → approve/decline → email; annual balance by seniority and age
Leave days counted against public holidays and working days, leave calendar and ICS
Weekly shift grid, templates, copy last week, publish; rest and 45-hour warnings
A no-login page for each employee: my shifts, balance, leave request

sss.s: Does it run payroll?
sss.c: No. The module covers staff, leave and shift planning only; keep using your accounting software for payroll and social security filings.

sss.s: Are the leave entitlements legally correct?
sss.c: Turkish Labour Law No. 4857 entitlements come as defaults and you can adjust them in settings for your workplace. Calculations are for information only.

hukuk_burosu.ozet: Client and matter tracking, hearing/deadline calendar with a deadline calculator, time and expense records, and a private status link for clients.
hukuk_burosu.kimIcin: Lawyers, law offices and in-house legal advisers.
ozellikler: Clients (individual/company) and matters: type, case number, court or enforcement office, opposing parties and their counsel, responsible lawyer
Conflict-of-interest warning: a new client's or opposing party's name/tax number is checked against existing records
Hearing and deadline calendar, ICS, reminders 7/3/1 days before; a helper deadline calculation based on Civil Procedure Code Art. 92/93/104
Time and expense records with a PDF statement; a link where clients see only what you share. Does not pull data from UYAP automatically

sss.s: Do matters from UYAP come in automatically?
sss.c: No. UYAP has no open interface, so nothing is pulled automatically and no scraping is done; the office enters matter details.

sss.s: Can the agency see our files?
sss.c: No. For support the agency sees only counts (matters, clients, upcoming deadlines, storage); matter content, notes, documents and client details are not shown.

marka_temasi.ozet: Open your customer pages with your brand, not the agency’s: logo, colours, typeface and corners in one place.
marka_temasi.kimIcin: Businesses and brands that want their business card, QR menu, booking or event pages to carry their own corporate identity.
ozellikler: Logo, primary and accent colour, light/dark background, corners and typeface
Applied to every customer page with one setting
Colour contrast check (WCAG AA) and automatic text colour
Logo header on booking, ticket and course emails

sss.s: Can I use my own domain?
sss.c: Not yet: pages stay on mehmetkuru.dev but look like your brand. Custom domain support will be offered separately later.

sss.s: Can one page use a different colour?
sss.c: Yes. If you picked a colour on a business card or menu, it keeps priority on that page; the brand theme only fills what is left.

restoran_kafe.ozet: A draft QR menu with ready categories (breakfast, starters, mains, desserts, drinks) and a thank-you text for your Google review page.

klinik_saglik.ozet: First visit (30 min), follow-up (15 min) and online pre-consultation appointments; a booking form that asks for no health data and a starter FAQ about bookings.

guzellik_kuafor.ozet: Haircut (45 min), colouring (120 min), blow-dry and manicure appointments with buffer times; opening hours, a business card draft and a salon FAQ.

spor_studyo.ozet: Personal training (60 min), group classes with limited places and intro appointments; seven-day opening hours and a studio FAQ.

danismanlik_kocluk.ozet: Intro call (20 min), consulting session (60 min) and follow-up; the video link goes out in the confirmation email, plus a corporate business card draft.

teknik_servis.ozet: Survey, repair and maintenance bookings (address and appliance questions, confirmed by phone); survey, repair and installation checklists; work orders from bookings.

egitim_etkinlik.ozet: Intro call and online trial lesson bookings; a newsletter list and a three-step welcome email series draft (nothing is sent).

ajans_serbest.ozet: Intro (30 min) and project call (60 min) bookings, a corporate business card draft linked to your booking page, and automation suggestions.

eticaret_kobi.ozet: An AI assistant draft with a starter FAQ on orders and contact; a newsletter list and a welcome email series draft (nothing is sent).

hukuk_burosu.ozet: Initial meeting (30 min), consultation (60 min) and online meeting booking types; an inactive business card draft; a measured FAQ draft visible to the team.
